title: Listening Drill — Lecture series change
description: Public announcement. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Lecture series change
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: A quick update about the guest lecture series. Some of you have printed the original programme, so please take a moment to change your notes. The most important change concerns entry requirements.

ORGANISER: For now, go to the central staircase. If that route is closed when you arrive, use the east lift instead. It takes a few minutes longer, so allow enough time.

ORGANISER: Questions should go to Ellie rather than the general enquiries desk. Before you leave, bring some form of identification. We will post a further update only if another part of the plan changes.
